correctness.rationale: For p,q>=2 the two named levels are intrinsic minimal and maximal worlds of the fixed complete height-two order, so every isomorphism respects A and B independently. With R reflexive/transitive, restrictions Q_A,Q_B are preorders. Forth-up for a R b with b maximal requires every B point to reach b, forcing the target into Top(Q_B), and transitivity closes its class; the A sources form a predecessor-closed ideal U. Forth-down dually forces B->A target in Top(Q_A), with B source ideal V. All four pieces of the normal form are sufficient for reflexivity, both confluences and transitivity, including two-cross-edge composites; this is acknowledged as previously proved. The normal form is unique and S_p×S_q-equivariant, hence an isomorphism class is exactly a pair of preorder classes decorated by permitted ideal-orbits, with automorphism group the stabilizer product. If o(Q) counts ideal orbits and t(Q) indicates top class, factors (1+t_B(o_A-1))(1+t_A(o_B-1)) sum to the stated four-term I_{p,q}. The greatest-class decomposition yields b_n=sum_{j<n}a_j and d_n=sum_{j<n}(a_j+c_j), with a0=c0=1, and Burnside computes c_n. Independent from-code finite checks enumerated all preorders/ideals through n=4 and all literal-axiom R on (2,2),(2,3), recovering a,b,c,d and 38/135/452/7034. Independently checked all 89+762+762+5922 constructed frame stabilizer orders for sizes (2,2),(2,3),(3,2),(3,3). These finite tests corroborate, but arbitrary p,q correctness rests on the equivariant structural proof.

value.rationale: Unlabelled modal-frame types and their automorphism groups are intrinsic finite-model-theoretic invariants of the natural complete two-level posets, not an arbitrary parameter slice. The conditional marked-ideal decomposition turns a whole infinite two-parameter family into explicit, computable orbit statistics and stabilizers; the nonfree group actions show why the known labelled numbers cannot simply be divided by p!q!. The first values 38,135,452 and the universal b,d recurrences are motivated exact structural data for classifying models up to renaming. The work is a relatively close and standard equivariant refinement of a prior labelled normal form, not a new logic or a broad decidability result; nevertheless it is a natural complete classification and concrete invariant, not just a table recomputation or a type check.
